name: USGS Earthquake GeoJSON Feed
good_for: Real-time event pipelines, map visualizations, magnitude/severity dashboards
provenance: verified in production - powers this program's earthquake_tracker project
notes: Pre-geocoded lat/long/depth, no geocoding step needed. Smaller windows (hour/day/week) available at the same path with a different filename.

name: NOAA SWPC Solar Flare Events (GOES X-ray)
update_cadence: as GOES data lands, effectively minutes
good_for: Discrete-event pipelines (begin/max/end time, flare class) - same shape as earthquake events
provenance: verified while scoping this program's space-weather tracker project
notes: No stable event id published by NOAA; a natural key has to be composed, e.g. (begin_time, satellite).

name: NOAA SWPC Planetary K-index
good_for: Time-series/severity charting (Kp >= 5 is a geomagnetic storm) rather than discrete events
provenance: verified while scoping this program's space-weather tracker project
notes: This is a continuous stream, not one row per event - pair with the flare feed above if you want both patterns in one project.

name: GDELT 2.0 Event Database
good_for: Global event/conflict monitoring, geo-tagged news event mining
provenance: verified in production - powers this program's tracking_metals conflict-hotspot pipeline
notes: URL requires a 15-minute-aligned UTC timestamp (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) in place of {TIMESTAMP}. 61 tab-separated columns per the GDELT 2.0 Event codebook - no header row, columns are positional.

name: Yahoo Finance quotes (via yfinance)
format: Python objects (via the yfinance package, not a documented HTTP API)
provenance: verified in production - powers this program's tracking_metals live price pipeline
notes: Unofficial: yfinance scrapes an undocumented Yahoo endpoint, not a published/stable API. It can break without notice - fine for a course project, risky for anything that needs to keep working unattended long-term.

name: Open-Meteo Weather Forecast & Historical API
update_cadence: hourly forecast; decades of historical data also available
good_for: Weather/climate projects - one of the few weather APIs with genuinely no signup step
provenance: catalog seed - not yet used in a project in this program, worth verifying before relying on it
notes: Free tier is rate-limited for non-commercial use (documented on their site); fine for coursework volumes.

name: World Bank Open Data API
provenance: catalog seed - not yet used in a project in this program, worth verifying before relying on it
notes: Swap the indicator code in the URL (e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD is GDP) for thousands of other tracked indicators.

name: REST Countries
good_for: A first API call - country metadata, capitals, currencies, borders, no time-series complexity
provenance: catalog seed - not yet used in a project in this program, worth verifying before relying on it
notes: Good for a warm-up assignment before tackling a real-time feed.

name: Open Notify - ISS Location & People in Space
good_for: The simplest possible first pipeline exercise - one endpoint, three fields, no auth, no pagination
provenance: catalog seed - not yet used in a project in this program, worth verifying before relying on it
notes: Small hobby project, not institutionally backed - uptime isn't guaranteed the way a government feed's is. Good for a first assignment, not for anything that needs to run unattended for months.
